judgments.reason: The span 'A patient with high myopia' is present in the vignette, but it only establishes high myopia without any mention of chorioretinal atrophy, so it does not clinically support the full modifier 'Pathologic myopia with chorioretinal atrophy'.

The span 'The axial length was 30.0 mm' is present in the vignette and supports pathologic myopia (axial length >26 mm), but it contains no reference to chorioretinal atrophy, so it does not clinically support the complete modifier.
The span 'a wide area of chorioretinal atrophy' is present literally in the vignette and directly supports the complication modifier 'Pathologic myopia with chorioretinal atrophy'.
